form: Un-mā̃h-tai chhōṭᵃnō bāp-taĩ bōlyō ak, ‘bābā-jī, māl-kō baṭ jō mū̃-nē̃ dīṇū̃ hōy, sō dē-dō.’
gloss: Them-in-from the-younger the-father-to said that, ‘father, the-property-of share which me-to to-be-given may-be, that give.’

form: ‘bābā-jī, māl-kō baṭ jō mū̃-nē̃ dīṇū̃ hōy, sō dē-dō.’
gloss: ‘father, the-property-of share which me-to to-be-given may-be, that give.’

form: Jab ū-nē̃ wō māl-kō baṭ jis tarah kahyō-thō, us-i tarah bā̃ṭ diyō.
gloss: Then him-by that property-of share which way said-it-was, in-that-very way having-divided it-was-given.

form: Thōṛā din pīchhē chhōṭō bēṭō sagᵃḷō māl jamā-kar-kē par-dēsā̃-nē̃ chalō-gayō; ar wathai apᵃṇū dhan bad-chalᵃnī-mē̃ khō-diyō.
gloss: A-few days after the-younger son all property collected-made-having foreign-countries-to went-away; and there his-own fortune evil-behaviour-in wasted.

form: Jab sab kharach kar-chukyō, aur wāh dēs-mē̃ baṛō kāḷ par-gayō, ar wōh kaṅgāl hō-gayō, tau wathai-hī wāhĩ dēs-kā bhāgᵃwān jimīdār-kē jā lagyō.
gloss: When all expenditure was- made-completely, and that country-in a-great famine fell, and he indigent became, then there-even that-very country-of a-rich landlord-to going he-engaged-himself.

form: Un wōh apᵃṇā khēt-mē̃ sūr charāwaṇ-nē̃ bhējō.
gloss: By-him he his-own fields-in swine feeding-for was-sent.

form: Ar un chāhī kē un chhōlᵃkā̃-taĩ, jō sūr khāy-thā, un-taĩ apᵃṇō pēṭ bharai; kyū̃-kē wāh-nē̃ kōī kimaĩ nāh dē-thō.
gloss: And by-him it-was-wished that those husks-by, which swine an-eating-were, them-by his-own belly he-may-fill; because him-to anybody anything not a-giving-was.

form: Jab surat sā̃bhār-kē kahī ak, ‘mhārē ghari kitᵃnā̃-hi mihinᵃtiyā̃-nē̃ rōṭī sai, ar maĩ bhūkhō marᵃtō dōḷū̃-sū̃. Maĩ uth-kē apᵃṇā bābā-jī kanai jāū̃gō ar un-taĩ kahū̃gō ki, ‘ma-nē̃ Dhaṇī-kō aur tumhārō alᵃbat khōṭ karyō-sai; ar ib maĩ isō nā rahyō ki phir tērō bēṭō kahlāū̃. Ar ib tū mū̃-nē̃ apᵃṇā mihinᵃtiyā̃-kī tarah-hī rākh-lē”’
gloss: Then senses arranged-having it-was-said that, ‘on-my on-house how-many-even labourers-to bread is, and I hungry dying wandering-am. I arisen-having my-own father near will-go and him-to I-will-say that, ‘me-by God-of and your surely evil-aped done-is; and now I such not remained that again thy son I-may-be-called. And now thou me thy-own labourers-of like-even keep.”’

form: Jab uṭhyā-taĩ apᵃṇā bāp pīlᵃnē chal-diyō.
gloss: Then arisen-having his-own father near he-started.

form: Aur wō abhī dūr thō ak dēkhᵃtā̃-hī wāh-kā bāp-nē̃ mahar ā-gai, aur bhāj-kē apᵃṇē galē lagā-liyō, aur bōhat pyār kiyō.
gloss: And he yet far was that on-seeing- even him-of father-to pity came, and run-having on-his-own on-neck he-was- attached, and much caress was-made.

form: Bēṭā-nē̃ kahī ak ‘bābā-jī, hamĩ Dhaṇī-kō aur tērō alᵃbat khōṭ karyō-sai. Ib maĩ tērō bēṭō kahlāwaṇ lāyak nā rahyō.’
gloss: The-son-by it-was-said that ‘father, I God-of and thy surely evil have-done. Now I thy son to-be-called worthy not remained.’

form: ‘bābā-jī, hamĩ Dhaṇī-kō aur tērō alᵃbat khōṭ karyō-sai. Ib maĩ tērō bēṭō kahlāwaṇ lāyak nā rahyō.’
gloss: ‘father, I God-of and thy surely evil have-done. Now I thy son to-be-called worthy not remained.’

form: Wāh-kō bāp apᵃṇā mihinᵃtiyā̃-nē̃ bōlyō ak, ‘achchhā- taĩ-achchhā kapᵃṛā āh-nē̃ pahᵃrāy-dō; ar āh-kā hāth-mē̃ gū̃ṭhī, aur pāwā̃-mē̃ jōṛī pahᵃrāy-dō; ar ham khā̃h ar khusī karā̃gā; kyū̃-kē mērē lēkhē mērē bēṭā-nē̃ phir-kē janm liyō-sai; khūryō, pāyō-sai.
gloss: Him-of father his-own labourers-to spoke that, ‘good- than-good clothes this-one-to put-on; and this-one-of hand-on a-ring, and feet-on (in) shoes put; and we may-eat and merriment shall-make; because in-my in-opinion my son-by again birth taken-is; was-lost, found-is.

form: ‘achchhā- taĩ-achchhā kapᵃṛā āh-nē̃ pahᵃrāy-dō; ar āh-kā hāth-mē̃ gū̃ṭhī, aur pāwā̃-mē̃ jōṛī pahᵃrāy-dō; ar ham khā̃h ar khusī karā̃gā; kyū̃-kē mērē lēkhē mērē bēṭā-nē̃ phir-kē janm liyō-sai; khūryō, pāyō-sai.

form: Jab ghar-kē nīṛē āyō gājā-bājā-nē̃ suṇ-kē apᵃṇā ēk mihinᵃti-nē̃ bōlyō ki, ‘yō kē sai?’ Un kahī kē, ‘tērō bhāī āyō-sai; aur tērā bābā-jī-nē̃ baṛī khātar-dārī kari-sai; nyū̃-ak wāh-taĩ rājī-khusī ā-milyō.’
gloss: When the-house-of near he-came music-etc.(obj.) heard-having his-own one labourer-to he-spoke that, ‘this what is?’ By-him it-was-said that, ‘thy brother come-is; and thy father-by a-great feast done-is; because-that him-by safe-and-sound having-come-he-was-met.’

form: ‘tērō bhāī āyō-sai; aur tērā bābā-jī-nē̃ baṛī khātar-dārī kari-sai; nyū̃-ak wāh-taĩ rājī-khusī ā-milyō.’
gloss: ‘thy brother come-is; and thy father-by a-great feast done-is; because-that him-by safe-and-sound having-come-he-was-met.’

form: Wōh chhōh hō-kar bhītar nāh gayō.
gloss: He angry become-having inside not went.

form: Wāh-kā bāp-nē̃ wō bāhar ā-kar-kē manāyō.
gloss: Him-of the-father-by he outside come-having he-was-appeased.

form: Un apᵃṇā bāp-taĩ kahī ak, ‘dēkh, maĩ itᵃnā baras-taĩ tērī ṭahal karū̃-sū̃; ar kadī tērō kahyō nā gēryō-sai; mal taĩ kadī mū̃-nē̃ ēk bakᵃrī-kō bachchō nā diyō jāh-taĩ maĩ bhī apᵃṇā piārā ḍhabbiyā̃-kī khātar karᵃtō. Ib jab-taĩ tērō yō bēṭō āyō ar in tērō sagᵃḷō dhan kisᵃbaṇā̃-nē̃ khuwā-luṭā-diyō tamhī-nē̃ wāh-kī bōhat khātar karī.’
gloss: By-him his-own father-to it-was-said that, ‘see, I so-many years-since thy service doing-am; and ever thy sayings not disobeyed-is; but thou ever me-to one she-goat-of young-one not was-given which-with I also my-own dear companions-of feasting might-have-done. Now since thy this son came and by-this-one thy all fortune harlots-to was-squandered-away thee-even-by him-of great feasting was-done.’

form: Un wāh-nē̃ kahī, ‘bēṭā, tū sadā-taĩ mērē dhōrē sā; kimaĩ mērō tērō dō nāhī sai. Tū-nē̃ bī chāw karᵃṇō thō, ak tērā in bhāī-nē̃ phir-kē janm liyō-sai; ak khūyō, aur phir milyō-sai-gō.
gloss: By-him him-to it-was-said, ‘son, thou ever-from me-of near art; whatever mine thine two not is. Thee-to also merry-making to-be-done was, that thy this brother-by again birth taken-is; that lost-was, and again (he) found-is.
